messages:
anya: Quick sync — NimbusCloud EU roadshow confirmed for AMS (May 12), FRA (May 15), and LON (May 18). Need to lock: speaker(s), final demo kit list, swag allowances, customs paperwork, and AV capture plan. Can folks update status by EOD? :ship:

mike: On it. I'll confirm speaker slots with Nimbus today and grab co-brand logos. Also need sponsor badge counts — anyone have the latest?

sandra: Events ops here. Badge counts: AMS 2 staff + 1 speaker, FRA 3 staff + 1 speaker, LON 2 staff + 1 speaker. Shipping deadlines: for DDP courier we need parcels out by May 1 for on-time arrival. If we're shipping with Li-ion batteries we need battery declarations and it'll add ~5 days. Link to runbook: https://notion.redwood/integrations/roadshow (updated). :calendar:

tomasz: Hardware ops — demo kit is one rack case ~18kg, 1 external battery pack (powerbank) and 1 spare NVMe. Power: bring IEC C13 + EU Schuko adapter. If powerbank contains >100Wh we can't air-freight as standard cargo. Suggest sourcing powerbanks in EU to avoid battery shipping headaches.

kelsey: Legal/compliance note: swag value matters for customs. If tees/powerbanks >45 EUR per recipient some countries treat them differently. We should declare goods as "on loan for demo — no commercial sale" on the proforma invoice. Also: if we're recording people at the booth, we need clear signage/consent — Nimbus wants that covered.

josh: Demo engineer check-in — will present the low-latency Redwood Dedicated path (live) and fallback to hosted API if load spikes. Need 6-minute live demo script + 2 short backup videos (2m and 1m). Can someone help produce the 1m fallback recording? I can do the live narration. Quick start command we'll use on booth machine: ```redwood serve --model redwood-2b --quantize auto --port 8080```

anya: @josh thanks — can you produce the script draft by next Tue (Apr 28)? Also need 3 co-branded slides (logo, architecture diagram, CTA). I'll own speaker confirmations once josh confirms he's good. :white_check_mark:

mike: Confirmed with Nimbus: they can provide 1 co-presenter in AMS and FRA, remote co-host for LON. They'll also supply a banner and table runner — send them the final logo SVG.

sandra: Swag plan: recommended local sourcing for powerbanks and bulk tees. We'll order 400 stickers, 250 tees (sizes S-XL), and 150 reusable water bottles. Powerbanks — prefer EU vendor unless someone approves battery paperwork. Also we have a limit on carry-on for people shipping personally.

deploy-bot: Document updated: Roadshow logistics checklist -> https://notion.redwood/roadshow/packlist (edited by sandra) :gear:

tomasz: Packing list (draft) below — I'll finalize and hand off to ops. Please confirm missing items asap.

```
- 1 x demo case (18kg)
- 1 x booth laptop (Dell XPS) + IEC C13 cable
- 1 x external powerbank (EU-sourced preferred)
- 2 x network dongles (ethernet)
- 1 x USB-C hub
- 1 x spare NVMe
- co-branded slide USB stick
- 1 x HDMI -> DisplayPort adapter
- asset tag list + serials
```

kelsey: Logistics reminder — proforma invoice template needs: description "demo equipment on loan", HS code 8471.80, estimated value (set low but realistic), and return date. Also tracker for asset export licenses if any component is controlled tech — josh please confirm components list.

josh: Confirmed: no controlled hardware, just standard NVMe and inference GPU in the unit (consumer-grade). I'll post the mini demo script later today with timestamps for the 6-min run. Also will record the 2m fallback clip if no volunteer — can do it after lunch.

anya: Great — action items: mike to send Nimbus logo by EOD, josh script draft by Apr 28, sandra finalize courier booking and local swag procurement plan by Apr 30, tomasz finalize packing list and serials by Apr 29, kelsey will prepare proforma template. If we hit these, shipping window looks good. Thanks everyone! :rocket:
